_meta.note: Memberships as publicly known for 2025/early 2026. Ids = Natural Earth ADM0_A3. Editorial judgment is marked in `obs`. kind=defense only for treaties with real mutual-defence commitments.

alliances.name: OTAN (NATO)
alliances.obs: 32 members; Finland (2023) and Sweden (2024) included. Article 5.

alliances.name: OTSC (CSTO)
alliances.obs: Armenia froze participation in 2024 but has not formally left.

alliances.name: AUKUS
alliances.obs: Trilateral security partnership (nuclear submarines, advanced capabilities).

alliances.name: ANZUS
alliances.obs: Treaty still in force; US-NZ obligations suspended since 1986.

alliances.name: Tratado de Segurança EUA-Japão
alliances.obs: 1960 Treaty of Mutual Cooperation and Security.

alliances.name: Tratado de Defesa Mútua EUA-Coreia do Sul
alliances.obs: 1953 Mutual Defense Treaty.

alliances.name: Tratado de Defesa Mútua EUA-Filipinas
alliances.obs: 1951 Mutual Defense Treaty.

alliances.name: Estado da União Rússia-Bielorrússia
alliances.obs: Union State with mutual security guarantees (2024 treaty).

alliances.name: Tratado de Parceria Estratégica Rússia-Coreia do Norte
alliances.obs: June 2024 comprehensive strategic partnership with mutual-defence clause (Art. 4).

alliances.name: Tratado China-Coreia do Norte
alliances.obs: 1961 Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance.

alliances.name: Declaração de Shusha Turquia-Azerbaijão
alliances.obs: 2021 mutual assistance clause.

alliances.name: Acordo de Defesa Mútua Arábia Saudita-Paquistão
alliances.obs: Strategic Mutual Defense Agreement signed September 2025.

alliances.name: Aliança dos Estados do Sahel (AES)
alliances.obs: Liptako-Gourma mutual-defence charter (2023); confederation 2024.

alliances.name: União Europeia
alliances.obs: 27 members. Has a mutual-assistance clause (TEU 42.7) but is classed economic/political here.

alliances.name: BRICS (ampliado)
alliances.obs: Full members as of 2025 (Indonesia joined Jan 2025). Saudi Arabia invited but not confirmed; partner countries excluded.

alliances.name: Organização de Cooperação de Xangai (OCX/SCO)
alliances.obs: Belarus joined 2024. Security/political cooperation, no mutual-defence clause.

alliances.name: Five Eyes
alliances.obs: Signals-intelligence sharing alliance.

alliances.name: Quad (Diálogo de Segurança Quadrilateral)
alliances.obs: Security dialogue, no treaty obligations.

alliances.name: G7
alliances.obs: Political forum (EU not counted as a country).

alliances.name: Liga Árabe
alliances.obs: 22 members (Syria readmitted 2023). Joint Defence Treaty exists but is not operational; classed political.

alliances.name: União Africana
alliances.obs: 55 members incl. suspended states (Mali, Burkina Faso, Niger, Sudan, Guinea, Gabon status varies) and Sahrawi Republic.

alliances.name: CEDEAO (ECOWAS)
alliances.obs: After the withdrawal of Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger (Jan 2025).

alliances.name: ASEAN
alliances.obs: Timor-Leste admitted as 11th member in October 2025.

alliances.name: Mercosul
alliances.obs: Bolivia full member since 2024; Venezuela suspended.

alliances.name: T-MEC / USMCA
alliances.obs: Free-trade agreement.

alliances.name: Conselho de Cooperação do Golfo (CCG)
alliances.obs: Has a Joint Defence Agreement and the Peninsula Shield Force; classed political here (no integrated mutual-defence obligation in practice).

alliances.name: OPEP+
alliances.obs: OPEC members plus the Declaration of Cooperation partners (Angola left in Jan 2024).

alliances.name: Five Power Defence Arrangements
alliances.obs: Consultative arrangement, no automatic defence obligation.

conflicts.obs: Gaza war since Oct 2023; fragile ceasefire since Oct 2025.
M23 conflict in eastern DRC, Rwandan involvement alleged/acknowledged by UN experts.
